name: sidenav
gotchas: `mat-sidenav-content` must be the sibling immediately following the `mat-sidenav`(s) inside `mat-sidenav-container` — the container measures and positions content based on that structure, not arbitrary nesting.

`mode="side"` permanently reserves layout space, while the default `"over"` overlays content. Toggling between modes responsively (e.g. via BreakpointObserver) without also toggling `opened` can leave a `side` sidenav permanently visible.

`mat-sidenav-container` needs an explicit height from its own ancestor layout (e.g. `height: 100vh` on a wrapping element) — without one, the sidenav's scrolling/backdrop calculations collapse to zero height.
